# Workspace AIChat config

WiP configuration for the `aichat` LLM CLI tool.  

Currently provides:
- Coder Agent
- Tester Agent
- Documentation role
- Spell checker role
- Brainstorming role

**See:**  
- https://github.com/sigoden/aichat
- https://github.com/sigoden/llm-functions
- https://github.com/sigoden/argc
